name: FrenchModelVariant335_HandleRequest
evidence: matching french_model_variant/variant335_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4; for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, gets the slot part, uploads the texture images and sets up the effect records, otherwise it runs one frame (from the config start frame: ribbons and sheets before phase 7, streamers and rings from phase 5, then tint and fade) and returns 4 in phases 6-8, then 1 once and 2; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md); notes/overlays/french-model-variant335.md
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the North American and Japanese images build it through model_variant/variant318_entry.c with palette x 512 and data offset 0. French header numbering 335 (North American header 318). HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
